title: Design System: SIDA Pro（数智分析 Pro）

primary.displayName: 锚点钢蓝（暗色提亮至 hsl(240 70% 60%)）

display.purpose: 指数点位/大额资金/温度读数——DIN 风格数字 + tabular-nums，只给一眼必须看到的大数字。

micro.purpose: 口径标签/来源/时间戳——所有资金数据必须随附的诚实层。

shadows.name: float
shadows.purpose: 全站唯一阴影档，只给真浮层（弹窗/菜单/命令面板）。

shadows.name: card-static
shadows.purpose: 卡片静态微影/暗色顶部内高光。

shadows.name: card-hover
shadows.value: 亮色 0 4px 14px -6px hsl(240 15% 40% / 0.16)；暗色表面亮度抬升一档 + 内高光 0.06
shadows.purpose: hover 层级 = 亮度抬升，无彩色阴影。

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: 默认出场缓动。注意：prefers-reduced-motion 在 token 层全局归零。

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: 锚点钢蓝主操作按钮，active 轻压。用于页面级确认动作。
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; padding: 10px 16px; background: hsl(240 70% 45%); color: #fff; border: none; border-radius: 6px; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; font-family: Inter, system-ui, 'PingFang SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.16,0.84,0.44,1), transform 150ms cubic-bezier(0.16,0.84,0.44,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: hsl(240 70% 40.5%); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.96); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid hsl(240 70% 45%); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: 浮层灰底 + hairline 边框的次级按钮。
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; padding: 10px 16px; background: hsl(240 15% 92%); color: hsl(240 20% 10%); border: 1px solid hsl(240 15% 90%); border-radius: 6px; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500; font-family: Inter, system-ui, 'PingFang SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.16,0.84,0.44,1), transform 150ms cubic-bezier(0.16,0.84,0.44,1); } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: hsl(240 15% 88%); } .ds-btn-secondary:active { transform: scale(0.96); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid hsl(240 70% 45%); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Card
components.description: 纸面白结论容器：8px 圆角 + 强边框 + 静态微影（暗色为顶部内高光）。
components.css: .ds-card { background: hsl(240 25% 99%); border: 1px solid hsl(240 17% 27.5%); border-radius: 8px; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px hsl(240 15% 40% / 0.05), inset 0 1px 0 hsl(0 0% 100% / 0.4); padding: 12px 16px; font-family: Inter, system-ui, 'PingFang SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif; } .ds-card-title { font-size: 11px; font-weight: 500; color: hsl(240 10% 48%); } .ds-card-num { font-family: 'DIN Alternate', Bahnschrift, 'SF Mono', monospace; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; font-size: 20px; font-weight: 700; color: hsl(240 20% 10%); }

components.name: Quote Row
components.description: 行情列表行：32px 命中区 + hover 亮度抬升 + 左侧角色条；红涨绿跌同色异向。
components.html: 神剑股份002361+3.21%
components.css: .ds-row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 32px; padding: 0 8px; position: relative; font-size: 12px; font-family: Inter, system-ui, 'PingFang SC', sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-row::before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0 auto 0 0; width: 2px; border-radius: 2px; background: hsl(245 65% 62%); } .ds-row:hover { background: hsl(240 20% 96%); } .ds-row-name { font-weight: 500; color: hsl(240 20% 10%); } .ds-row-code { font-family: 'SF Mono', monospace; font-size: 11px; color: hsl(240 10% 48%); } .ds-row-chg { margin-left: auto; font-family: 'DIN Alternate', Bahnschrift, monospace; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; font-weight: 600; } .ds-up { color: #ff5252; } .ds-down { color: #43a047; }

components.name: Caliber Badge
components.description: 口径徽章：全站资金数据的诚实层，10px 字号，随数据出现。
components.html: tdx_exday4
components.css: .ds-caliber { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 1px 6px; border-radius: 9999px; background: hsl(240 15% 92%); color: hsl(240 10% 48%); font-size: 10px; font-family: 'SF Mono', monospace; line-height: 16px; cursor: help; }

components.name: Input Field
components.description: 标准输入框：hairline 边框，focus 转 primary + 轻环。
components.html: <input class="ds-input" placeholder="输入6位股票代码, 逗号分隔" />
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; height: 40px; padding: 0 12px; border: 1px solid hsl(240 15% 90%); border-radius: 6px; background: hsl(240 20% 95.5%); color: hsl(240 20% 10%); font-size: 13px; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; transition: border-color 150ms, box-shadow 150ms; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: hsl(240 10% 48%); } .ds-input:focus { outline: none; border-color: hsl(240 70% 45%); box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px hsl(240 70% 45% / 0.2); }

components.name: Nav Item (sidebar)
components.description: 侧栏导航项：可点击暗示（箭头/高亮卡）是硬要求。
components.html: ✦数智参谋AI 帮你分析股票 · 点击进入›
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 8px 10px; margin-bottom: 8px; border: 1px solid hsl(245 65% 62% / 0.4); background: hsl(240 25% 99%); border-radius: 12px; text-decoration: none; color: hsl(240 20% 10%); font-family: Inter, system-ui, 'PingFang SC', sans-serif; transition: background-color 150ms; } .ds-nav:hover { background: hsl(240 15% 92%); } .ds-nav-icon { font-size: 14px; color: hsl(245 65% 62%); } .ds-nav-text { flex: 1; min-width: 0; } .ds-nav-label { display: block; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; } .ds-nav-sub { display: block; font-size: 10px; color: hsl(240 10% 48%); } .ds-nav-arrow { color: hsl(245 65% 62% / 0.7); font-size: 12px; }

components.name: Heat Cell
components.description: OKLCH 均匀发散强度阶的单元格，红绿双向 + 文字保证色盲可读。
components.css: .ds-heat { display: inline-block; padding: 2px 6px; border-radius: 2px; font-family: 'DIN Alternate', Bahnschrift, monospace; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; font-size: 11px; color: hsl(240 20% 10%); } .ds-heat-p4 { background: oklch(0.75 0.16 25); } .ds-heat-n3 { background: oklch(0.80 0.13 155); }

narrative.northStar: 操盘手的驾驶舱（The Operator's Cockpit）
narrative.overview: 一台在高压力、高节奏交易时段里快速决策的行情终端。结论先行、口径诚实：每屏先回答『现在怎么办』再铺证据，每个数字可追溯口径。中性色收敛在 240 蓝紫锚点相（反 AI 模板），卡片是纸面白而非纯白——密度高但层级清楚。2026-10-24 起去卡片化解禁：hairline 仍是默认语言，卡片/阴影按收益自由使用。
keyCharacteristics: 红涨绿跌是全站最强的两种颜色，其他颜色不得竞争
Surface 阶梯 s0-s4 表达空间层级
字号六档制 + 全数字 tabular-nums
微圆角终端语言，暗色靠明度差不靠阴影
图表画布永远比外壳更空一档

rules.name: 红绿即秩序 Rule
rules.body: 涨跌语义色是屏幕上最强对比，primary/角色色/强调橙任何情况下不得比红绿更抢眼。同屏多口径资金数据必须各带 caliber 标签，禁止跨源混算。

rules.name: 无数据即无数据 Rule
rules.body: 缺数据显式标注「无数据/口径缺口」，禁止用 0、-- 编造或 LLM 推测填充。

rules.name: 六档铁律 Rule
rules.body: 字号只允许 10/11/12/13/16/20；一切数字 tabular-nums；金额量自动亿/万缩放。

rules.name: 单浮层阴影 Rule
rules.body: shadow-lg/xl/2xl 禁用；非浮层信息用 hairline 表达；多档阴影混用表达伪层级是禁手。

dos: 用 Surface 阶梯表达空间层级
给每个可交互元素可点击暗示
涨跌场景同时给颜色+符号/文字/位置
同屏多口径各带 caliber 徽章，结论放表头
列表行走 hairline，结论块用 card 按收益判断
donts: 非语义色比红绿更抢眼；彩色阴影/光晕
0 冒充缺失、跨源换算、无基准胜率
混用「数智参谋」与「数智决策」功能名
六档之外字号；手写金额换算
绕过 motion token 的动画
